Born from real life

GOOD FOOD.
NO COMPROMISE.

CHOW started with chef Chris Kindred, his love for bold Asian flavors, and a simple idea: gluten-free food shouldn't feel like a compromise.

After serving in the Army, Chris graduated from the Iowa Culinary Institute in 2019. His time living in South Korea—especially eating street food in Seoul's Itaewon neighborhood—helped shape the flavors he wanted to cook.

When Chris met his wife, Katie, who has celiac disease and has eaten gluten-free since 2006, he began recreating the foods she missed. Friends and family couldn't believe the food was completely gluten-free. After marrying in 2024, Chris and Katie turned the idea into CHOW.

American–Asian comfort food. Made from scratch. 100% gluten-free.
